describe.summary: Send mail from the owner's own Gmail address, to the recipients the policy allows; it cannot read the mailbox.

status.doc: Whether the credential works, the policy's caps, today's send count.

params.name: reply_pubkey
params.doc: secp256k1 public key (33 bytes compressed) to seal the policy to when the answer lands on chain.

send.doc: One message, policy-checked, then sent under the owner's address.

params.name: to
params.doc: Bare addresses only: no display names, no angle brackets.

params.name: attachments
params.doc: {filename, content_type, data: base64}; the policy decides whether attachments go.
